module_title: Agentic Software Engineering & The New SDLC
course_title: Agentic Software Engineering & The New SDLC
description: A high-rigor, hands-on exploration of the AI-transformed Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Students transcend casual 'vibe coding' to engineer deterministic agent harnesses, enforce specification-driven development (SDD), design Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) tool servers, manage context token economics, and orchestrate automated test-driven multi-agent pipelines.
learning_outcomes: Differentiate casual vibe coding from disciplined agentic engineering using Google's 10/90 Harness Rule.
Formulate machine-actionable specifications using EARS syntax and repository rule governance (AGENTS.md).
Engineer Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) tool servers with Pydantic contracts and sandbox execution.
Architect progressive disclosure skill registries to eliminate context pollution and optimize token economics.
Implement closed-loop, test-driven self-healing agent pipelines with automated regression verification.
